subject: Medford Square District Improvement Financing
overview: The Committee of the Whole met with municipal staff and consultants to review a proposed District Improvement Financing (DIF) plan for Medford Square. The committee voted to receive the presentation and place it on file ahead of a formal ordinance submission.

items.title: Medford Square District Improvement Financing Presentation
items.summary: City planning staff and consultants presented a proposed District Improvement Financing master plan to dedicate 50 percent of future new growth tax revenues within Medford Square toward local infrastructure and utility improvements, and the committee voted to receive the matter and place it on file.
